definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the typed word-sequence encoding as an empty MPY value sequence.
Recursive equation defining how a typed word sequence is encoded as an MPY sequence of string values.
Named expansion of the translated loop body used to keep the proof claims compact.
definitions.text:
rule findMaxLoopBody
    => Assign(
         Name("unique"),
         Call(Name("len"), Call(Name("set"), Name("word"))))
       If(Compare(Name("unique"), CmpOp(">", Name("max_unique"))),
         Assign(Name("best"), Name("word"))
         Assign(Name("max_unique"), Name("unique")),
         If(Compare(Name("unique"), CmpOp("==", Name("max_unique"))),
           If(Compare(Name("word"), CmpOp("<", Name("best"))),
             Assign(Name("best"), Name("word")),
             .Stmts),
           .Stmts))

definitions.rationale: Named expansion of the complete translated function body used by the verification claims.
definitions.text:
rule findMaxFunctionBody
    => Assign(Name("best"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("max_unique"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("word"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("unique"), Int(0))
       For(Name("word"), Name("words"), findMaxLoopBody)
       Return(Name("best"))

definitions.rationale: Base case of the mathematical accumulator, returning its current selected word and score.
definitions.text:
rule findMaxWords(.WordSeq, BEST:IntSeq, SCORE:Int)
    => bestState(BEST, SCORE)

definitions.rationale: Recursive accumulator equation for replacing the selection when the next word has a greater distinct-character score.
definitions.text:
rule findMaxWords(
         wCons(WORD:IntSeq, REST:WordSeq),
         _BEST:IntSeq,
         SCORE:Int)
    => findMaxWords(REST, WORD, isLen(dedupCodes(WORD)))
    requires isLen(dedupCodes(WORD)) >Int SCORE

definitions.rationale: Recursive accumulator equation for selecting the lexicographically smaller word when distinct-character scores tie.
definitions.text:
rule findMaxWords(
         wCons(WORD:IntSeq, REST:WordSeq),
         BEST:IntSeq,
         SCORE:Int)
    => findMaxWords(REST, WORD, SCORE)
    requires isLen(dedupCodes(WORD)) ==Int SCORE
     andBool strLt(WORD, BEST)

definitions.rationale: Recursive accumulator equation retaining the current selection when the next score is smaller.
definitions.text:
rule findMaxWords(
         wCons(WORD:IntSeq, REST:WordSeq),
         BEST:IntSeq,
         SCORE:Int)
    => findMaxWords(REST, BEST, SCORE)
    requires isLen(dedupCodes(WORD)) <Int SCORE

definitions.rationale: Recursive accumulator equation retaining the current selection for a tied score without a lexicographically smaller candidate.
definitions.text:
rule findMaxWords(
         wCons(WORD:IntSeq, REST:WordSeq),
         BEST:IntSeq,
         SCORE:Int)
    => findMaxWords(REST, BEST, SCORE)
    requires isLen(dedupCodes(WORD)) ==Int SCORE
     andBool notBool strLt(WORD, BEST)

definitions.rationale: Structural projection equation defining the selected-word component of a best-state summary.
Structural projection equation defining the score component of a best-state summary.
Definitional projection-unfolding equation for the selected word in the greater-score accumulator branch.
definitions.text:
rule bestWord(findMaxWords(wCons(WORD:IntSeq, REST:WordSeq), _BEST:IntSeq, SCORE:Int))
    => bestWord(findMaxWords(REST, WORD, isLen(dedupCodes(WORD))))
    requires isLen(dedupCodes(WORD)) >Int SCORE
    [simplification]
